page: Amazon Web Services m6idn.12xlarge is a general-purpose, network and EBS-optimized server instance built on the Nitro hypervisor. It features 48 vCPUs and 24 physical cores powered by an Intel Xeon 8375C processor running at 3.5 GHz. The x86_64 architecture includes 192.0 GB of DDR4 memory running at 3 GHz, translating to 4.0 GB of RAM per core. Local storage is provided via a bundled 2850 GB NVMe SSD instance store volume, and the instance delivers a baseline network bandwidth of 75 Gbps.

Benchmark results place the m6idn.12xlarge in the average performance tier for most compute and memory operations. It achieves a Geekbench single-core score of 1669.0 and a multi-core score of 15879.0. The instance demonstrates strong performance in specific workloads, scoring in the top 25% for Geekbench image processing (15350.0) and Passmark CPU encryption (43656.33). Memory bandwidth tests show a read-only small block cached speed of 2506.05 GB/sec and a large block uncached write speed of 69.5 GB/sec.

From a resource density perspective, the m6idn.12xlarge offers a balanced hardware profile, combining high-speed networking, local NVMe storage, and dedicated Intel Xeon compute resources. This configuration is suitable for workloads requiring high network throughput and fast local scratch space, such as database operations, static web serving, software compilation, and general-purpose enterprise applications.
